answer_1.quote: By converting natural language (NL) questions into executable forms (i.e., Structured Query Language or SQL), text-to-SQL parsers relieve users from the burden of learning about techniques behind the queries.

answer_2.quote: We report the accuracy of SQL exact matching (SQLAcc) and the accuracy of execution (ExeAcc).

answer_4.quote: We carry out the evaluation of PIIA with real users. The human evaluation is performed on the more complex Spider dataset and with two state-of-the-art parsers, i.e., IRNet and IRNet+BERT. We randomly sample 300 NL questions from the Spider development set and invite 30 volunteers majoring in liberal arts to interact with the PIIA agent.
answer_4.guideline: Users interact with PIIA by answering multi-choice questions to provide feedback.
